# Vendored third-party assets

These files are vendored so the web UI works without any external
network requests (see issue #5). Do not edit them by hand; re-download
the upstream releases if an upgrade is needed.

- `pico.min.css` — Pico CSS v2.1.1
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@picocss/pico@2/css/pico.min.css
  License: MIT (https://github.com/picocss/pico)

- `alpine.min.js` — Alpine.js v3.15.12
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3/dist/cdn.min.js
  License: MIT (https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine)
